visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty three: a lovely abacus (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js city balcony (plank deck, railing, planters, a sliding door and window, neighbouring buildings, sky), a round bistro table with coffee, a croissant, three phones and a notebook, an abacus whose beads slide one at a time, box-built creator with a beaded high ponytail, red glasses and a green sweater, phone sheets for three apps' stats / a screenshot roll / a handwritten sum / YourBrand handles / YourBrand analytics, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.7 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: Sunday is numbers day on her balcony. She posts on three apps; one says views, one says plays, one says impressions. She screenshots everything, adds it up by hand, and it takes all morning, so she buys an abacus. Then YourBrand: she adds her handles once, her tracked accounts are on one page (views, likes, engagement) and it updates for her. Sunday is hers again. She kept the abacus. It is a lovely abacus.
